explication: NiubiGEO is a self-hosted AI-visibility research product: users configure a domain and models, run repeatable recognition or keyword measurements, and inspect answers, citations, and reports. Its product workflow is distinct from the legacy audit and monitoring services, which add scheduled baseline runs and change notifications. The graph preserves those branches and the provider/configuration layers. Some subsystem links are documented only at product level in the README; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
